Name: Upgrade Sprinklers Unofficial
Author: OrchidCourage
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16689]Original mod here[/url]﻿

People in the comments of the original mod were asking for support for prismatic sprinklers, so I added that as well as line sprinklers. If anyone has suggestions/requests for support for other mods that add sprinklers, let me know and I will see if I can add it.

All upgrade recipes use the materials to make the next stage of sprinkler, minus the cost to make the previous one. (e.g: upgrading a quality sprinkler to an iridium sprinkler takes the materials to make an iridium sprinkler, minus the materials used to make a quality sprinkler.)

Translations are supported, however currently there is only a file for english. If anyone would like to create translation files for other languages, please send them to me so I can add them.

This version of the mod adds support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21450]Prismatic Tools Continued[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23895]Line Sprinklers Redux[/url], creating recipes to upgrade the sprinklers from those mods. These recipes will only appear if the relevant mod is installed, so there is no need to worry about having broken or impossible to craft recipes in your crafting menu if you do not have the mod for them.

There is also an option to make the upgrade recipes unnecessary for perfection if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31247]Perfection Exclusions[/url], and to add crafting recipes to turn line sprinklers back into regular ones.

This mod does not use any assets or code from Prismatic Tools or Line Sprinklers, it only adds new crafting recipes that use materials from those mods. While the added recipes do display using sprites from those mods, that is due to how crafting recipes work, the mod files themselves contain nothing from those mods.

If the creators of Prismatic Tools Continued or Line Sprinklers Redux have issues with the added recipes, please tell me and I will remove or edit them. If the creator of Upgrade Sprinklers would like me to take down this mod, I will do that.

Things I would like to add in future:[list]
[*]Unique sprites for upgrade recipes
[/list]
